note: Archer County (TX) publishes no zoning districts layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. Archer City has a zoning ordinance (Exhibit 14A, ecode360) whose Zoning District Map is kept at the municipal building and not published as a queryable service; the city site's only map is a water-restriction PDF. ArcGIS search for Archer County zoning found nothing; the county GIS offerings are paid parcel shapefiles and Pro-only viewers.
